name: BaddieSmash ( Coming soon )
description: Open-source multimodal language architecture (weights will not be released). Currently, BaddieSmash V0.1 is a clean, lightweight model that you can train on image + text datasets to respond with text. The architecture is easily adaptable to video and audio modalities — the BaddieSmash architecture release is coming soon, followed by BaddieSmashStar (currently in beta), the actual interactive agent you can talk to and have execute tasks for you (:
